goodToKnow: Die Wildbahn appears almost only in the phrase in freier Wildbahn (in the wild): Tiere in freier Wildbahn beobachten. Jokingly, people also use it for humans in their natural habitat. Several species have returned to Germany's freie Wildbahn, such as the wolf, and the lynx, reintroduced in the Harz from 2000. Das Wild means game animals. It has no plural.
